gloss: to be revived; to come back to life

definitions.gloss: to be resurrected; to come back to life
definitions.explanation: To return from death or apparent death; to be revived.

definitions.gloss: to be revived; to be restored
definitions.explanation: For something dormant, forgotten, or declining to regain vitality or prominence.

examples.japanese: {記憶|きおく}が{蘇|よみがえ}った。
{古|ふる}い{街|まち}が{蘇|よみがえ}った。
{心肺|しんぱい}{蘇生|そせい}で{彼|かれ}は{蘇|よみがえ}った。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). No transitive pair.

WRITING: Also written as {甦|よみがえ}る or in hiragana.

ETYMOLOGY: From {黄泉|よみ} (the underworld in Japanese mythology) + {帰|かえ}る (to return).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{記憶|きおく}が{蘇|よみがえ}る (memories come back)
・{活気|かっき}が{蘇|よみがえ}る (vitality is restored)
・{思|おも}い{出|で}が{蘇|よみがえ}る (memories revive)

RELATED:
・{蘇生|そせい} (resuscitation)
・{復活|ふっかつ} (revival, resurrection)
